name: My File 2 Link
description: Telegram bot by Mr.Aman that turns any Telegram file into a permanent direct download and streaming link.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org.

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API hash from my.telegram.org.

OWNER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram user ID. Get it from @missrose_bot with /info.

FLOG_CHANNEL.description: ID of the private channel where uploaded files are stored. Add the bot as admin.

ULOG_CHANNEL.description: ID of the private channel where new users are logged. Add the bot as admin.

FQDN.description: Public domain of your deployment, e.g. myfile2link.up.railway.app. Leave blank to use the bind address.

HAS_SSL.description: Set to True if your domain is served over HTTPS.

NO_PORT.description: Set to True to leave the port out of generated links (normal for hosted platforms).

PORT.description: Port the web server listens on.

OWNER_USERNAME.description: Mr.Aman's Telegram username without the @, used for the Contact button.

UPDATES_CHANNEL.description: Public updates channel username without the @.

FORCE_SUB.description: Set to True to require users to join FORCE_SUB_ID before using the bot.

FORCE_SUB_ID.description: Channel ID or username users must join when FORCE_SUB is enabled.

START_PIC.description: Override the built-in /start banner with your own image URL.

FILE_PIC.description: Override the built-in My Files banner with your own image URL.

VERIFY_PIC.description: Override the built-in verification banner with your own image URL.

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username for the /admin dashboard. Leave blank to keep the dashboard disabled.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Strong password for the /admin dashboard. Leave blank to keep the dashboard disabled.

AUTH_USERS.description: Space-separated user IDs allowed to use the bot. Leave blank to allow everyone.

SLEEP_THRESHOLD.description: Seconds of FloodWait Pyrogram will absorb automatically.
